expectations.text: The plan states that PCAO-F comes before PCAR-F and that passing both qualifies a candidate for the Panaversity FDE Internship Program.
expectations.evidence: Section 2 facts: 'Path: **PCAO-F → PCAR-F → FDE Internship Program**'. Guardrail: 'Do not say PCAO-F alone qualifies someone for the internship. **Both PCAO-F and PCAR-F** are needed.'

expectations.text: The plan makes clear that the PCAO-F/PCAR-F gate is Panaversity's requirement and that the Anthropic exams are optional or not prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: The first half is present: 'PCAO-F is Panaversity's readiness gate' and 'Do not imply Anthropic requires or endorses PCAO-F.' But the plan never says the Anthropic exams (CCAO-F/CCAR-F) are optional or not prerequisites for the gate or the internship. It calls CCAO-F 'the credential employers verify with Anthropic', W5-LI-1 says 'CCAO-F is the one worth carrying', and it offers Anthropic registration help 'for internship participants'. Whether the Anthropic exams are optional is never stated.

expectations.text: The plan does not state a specific amount for the Panaversity proctoring fee or third-attempt fee (it says they are unannounced, marks them to verify, or omits them).
expectations.evidence: Assumption 2: 'the external proctoring fee and the fee for a third or later attempt are "not announced yet." Content must not give a price'. Guardrail: 'Do not quote fees for externals or for a third attempt.' The only $99 figure is Anthropic's CCAO-F.

expectations.text: The plan does not promise or guarantee jobs, salaries, income, or an internship place to people who sit the exam.
expectations.evidence: Guardrail: 'Do not promise jobs or salaries. The book itself says the credentials are new and have "no mature salary data."' No content piece promises a job, income or an internship place.

expectations.text: The plan uses the free sample exam as a call to action in at least one content piece.
expectations.evidence: W3-YT-UR 'Ends with: try the free sample'; W3-IG-R 'Free sample exam: attempt kharch nahin hota'; W4 'Sample Exam Challenge ... Take the free sample this week'.

expectations.text: Every content piece listed in the plan is tagged with a language (English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu).
expectations.evidence: Every row of the Week 1–7 calendar tables has a Lang value (EN, Urdu, Roman Urdu, EN/UR, Urdu/EN, Bilingual, 'EN or UR (whichever did better)'). Week 0 items are setup and internal work (templates, glossary, scripts), not published pieces.

expectations.text: At least five content pieces in the plan point to a specific agentfactory.panaversity.org/docs page URL.
expectations.evidence: No calendar row cites a URL. The only URLs are in the Section 2 header ('Sources: ... https://agentfactory.panaversity.org/docs/certifications/pcao-f') and in Section 10 Sources. A blanket rule ('Every link goes to the PCAO-F page with UTM parameters') and vague references such as W3-LI-1 '(links to study guide pages)' don't tie specific pieces to specific docs URLs.

claims.claim: Retrieved through the Agent Factory System of Record (corpus generation 82)

suggestions.assertion: At least five content pieces in the plan point to a specific agentfactory.panaversity.org/docs page URL.
suggestions.reason: Borderline: the blanket 'every link goes to the PCAO-F page' rule could be read as satisfying this. Make it explicit that the URL must be attached to each piece.

eval_feedback.overall: A1, A3, A4 and A5 pass in both runs and do little to discriminate.
